schema.description: A configured usage limit and its value.

x-enumDescriptions.ORGANIZATION: Shared limit across the organization for the selected spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.DEFAULT_USER: Default per-user limit for the selected spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.DEFAULT_AGENT: Default aggregate limit applied to agents without an agent-specific limit.
x-enumDescriptions.USER: Limit for one user, identified by canonical user ID or email, and the selected spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.AGENT: Aggregate limit for one canonical agent ID, independent of spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.IDP_GROUP: Response-only source of an inherited per-user IdP-group limit.
x-enumDescriptions.DEPARTMENT: Response-only source of an inherited per-user department limit.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.ORGANIZATION: Shared limit across the organization for the selected spend client.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_USER: Default per-user limit for the selected spend client.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_AGENT: Default aggregate limit applied to agents without an agent-specific limit.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.USER: Limit for one user, identified by canonical user ID or email, and the selected spend client.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.AGENT: Aggregate limit for one canonical agent ID, independent of spend client.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.IDP_GROUP: Response-only source of an inherited per-user IdP-group limit.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.DEPARTMENT: Response-only source of an inherited per-user department limit.

user_id.description: Canonical user ID; valid only when type is USER. A USER target requires user_id, email, or both.

email.description: Email address of the user, including a known alias email; valid only when type is USER. Matching is case-insensitive and resolves to the canonical user_id. When user_id is also supplied, both must identify the same user. Email is never part of the stored limit key. Responses include the user's directory email when one is available.

agent_id.description: Canonical agent ID; required only when type is AGENT.

client_id.description: Opaque, case-sensitive spend-client ID, such as glean or an external gateway spend-client ID. Case and leading or trailing padding are preserved exactly; this is not inferred from the authenticating OAuth application, prefixed, or normalized. Empty and whitespace-only IDs (including Unicode whitespace), synthetic UI aggregation IDs, and control characters are invalid. Unknown IDs are valid and can have no applicable configured policies.

x-enumDescriptions.RECURRING_CALENDAR_MONTH: Resets at the start of each calendar month.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.RECURRING_CALENDAR_MONTH: Resets at the start of each calendar month.

allocation_mode.description: Required for ORGANIZATION, DEFAULT_USER, and DEFAULT_AGENT. Must not be provided for USER or AGENT targets.

x-enumDescriptions.SHARED_POOL: A single shared budget for the target population.
x-enumDescriptions.PER_MEMBER: A separate budget for each member of the target population.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.SHARED_POOL: A single shared budget for the target population.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.PER_MEMBER: A separate budget for each member of the target population.

allocation_mode.title: PlatformAllocationMode

value.description: Value, unit, and enforcement mode for the limit.

mode.description: Whether the limit has a finite cap or is unlimited.

x-enumDescriptions.FINITE: A finite value; amount is required for a configured cap and remaining for headroom.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.FINITE: A finite value; amount is required for a configured cap and remaining for headroom.

mode.title: PlatformAmountMode

amount.description: Plain non-negative decimal amount with at most six fractional digits; required when mode is FINITE and forbidden when mode is UNLIMITED. Limits use single-precision (float32) storage: inputs are rounded to that precision, and responses report the stored value rounded to six fractional digits. For example, 100.10 can be returned as 100.099998. This storage limitation does not reduce the precision of measured usage counters.

unit.description: Unit for the selected spend domain; must match its billing denomination. Aggregate agent limits use the workspace plan denomination.
unit.title: PlatformUsageUnit

enforcement.description: How the limit is enforced when reached.

x-enumDescriptions.HARD: Configured hard cap; when enforced, requests are blocked at the limit.
x-enumDescriptions.SOFT: Configured soft cap; when enforced, requests are allowed but flagged at the limit.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.HARD: Configured hard cap; when enforced, requests are blocked at the limit.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.SOFT: Configured soft cap; when enforced, requests are allowed but flagged at the limit.
